reasons: Pinch zoom is turned off, which is an accessibility problem.

terms.meaning: The outer page shell that wraps every screen in a Next.js app.
The step where the browser attaches interactivity to HTML that the server already drew.
The size and scale setting that controls how a page fits a phone or window.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and global setup
sections.what: Brings in the styles, the theme and state wrapper, and the error boundary that protects the whole app.
sections.watch_out: Moving or renaming the stylesheet import breaks styling everywhere.

sections.name: metadata
sections.title: Browser tab details
sections.what: Sets the title, description, install manifest and icon shown in the browser tab and when the app is saved to a home screen.
sections.why: Likely reason: branding and install support.

sections.name: viewport
sections.title: Mobile viewport settings
sections.what: Sets how the page fits phone screens and the theme color of the browser bar.
sections.watch_out: Maximum scale of 1 blocks pinch to zoom, which can make text hard to read for some users.

sections.name: RootLayout
sections.title: Root page frame
sections.what: Builds the outer HTML and body, loads the fonts, sets light and dark body colors, and wraps the app in the error boundary and providers.
sections.why: Every screen sits inside this frame.
sections.watch_out: The suppress-hydration setting can hide real differences between server and browser output.

summary: The outer frame of every page: it loads the styles, fonts, browser tab details and the app wrappers.
purpose: Makes sure every screen shares the same starting setup and error protection.
why: Likely reason: Next.js requires one root layout for the whole app.
how: 1) Loads the stylesheet, the theme and state wrapper, and the error boundary. 2) Sets browser tab title, description and icon. 3) Sets mobile viewport rules. 4) Renders the page frame with fonts, colors and the wrapped app content.
inputs: The page content passed in by Next.js.
outputs: The full HTML page shell for every route.
risks: Turning off pinch zoom hurts people who need to zoom in. Suppressing hydration warnings can hide real mismatches between server and browser output.
debug: If the whole app fails to show, check the imports at the top and the error boundary. If fonts look wrong, check the font links in the head section.
